comments.body: Sometimes people just have to understand what is clearly written. It says Rank 8. That rank 8 applies to Search, Appraisal and Unlock. good luck with map.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: To be fair, the translations aren't always correct, or entirely clear. I still remember that one bio map in EA that said it needed Unlock... anyway. A simple rule: search/recog/eco. research and unlock can be two levels below the number listed for your treasure/discovery map and still work, but the actual skill (appraisal in this case) must match the required skill level.
